The Neue Preussische Zeitung reports that the king, in a private letter, has expressed himself in terms of warm sympathy with the movement, and that several other persons of distinction have shown themselves favorable to the cause.

It appears also that a considerable number of prominent men are expected in Berlin, who will participate in the debate. There is nothing improbable in these rumors, for the German Bund, having the support of Austria and the other smaller states, has in its favor the general opinion of the people, and would undoubtedly be able to enforce respect for the constitution, even against the majority of the Reichstag. The most serious difficulty in the way of constitutional reform would seem to be that which lies in the antagonism between the Reichstag and the Bundestag.
